1. go to {location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)

Workflow: pick_up_and_place
When to use: when an object is found and needs to be moved to a specific destination
Steps:
1. take {object} from {location} (picking up the object)
2. go to {destination} (moving to the target location)
3. move {object} to {destination} (placing the object in the correct location)

Workflow: search_multiple_locations

3. go to {next_location} (searching another location for {object})
4. examine {next_location} (checking if {object} is present)

Steps:

2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. go to {next_location} (searching another location for {object})
4. examine {next_location} (checking if {object} is present)
5. repeat steps 3 and 4 for all remaining locations until {object} is found

3. take {object} from {location} (picking up the object)
